title: Pure Mayakashi
summary: Mayakashi cards only, with generic staples. Mayakashi are Zombies that lock the Extra Deck to Mayakashi and climb a ladder of Synchros you can only control one of each. Each Synchro revives the next one up from the GY when it falls, so destroying one Mayakashi Synchro brings back another. Hajun summons a Mayakashi from the Deck, Shafu revives one, Yasha discards a Mayakashi to summon itself, and Yuki-Musume returns from the hand or GY and mills a Zombie. Mayakashi Return searches or mills any Mayakashi card. Mayakashi Mayhem draws, Sets a Mayakashi Spell/Trap, or sends their weakest monster to the GY each time a Zombie Synchro is summoned outside the Extra Deck. Yuki-Onna, the Icicle Mayakashi, the newest card, negates a monster when summoned and revives a Zombie Synchro from the GY.
